heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 88–665, title VI, § 602, Oct. 16, 1964, 78 Stat. 1107

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 85–864, title VI, § 611, Sept. 2, 1958, 72 Stat. 1594; Pub. L. 87–344, title II, § 205(b), Oct. 3, 1961, 75 Stat. 760; Pub.
